verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 8.62
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 8.62

verses.pali: 7. Bhūmicālavagga
verses.english: 7. Earthquakes

verses.pali: Alaṁsutta
verses.english: Good Enough

verses.pali: “Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a mendicant with six qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Katamehi chahi?
verses.english: What six?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu;
verses.english: A mendicant is quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.

verses.pali: sutānañca dhammānaṁ dhāraṇajātiko hoti;
verses.english: They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.

verses.pali: dhātānañca dhammānaṁ atthūpaparikkhitā hoti;
verses.english: They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.

verses.pali: atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammappaṭipanno ca hoti;
verses.english: Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.

verses.pali: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo, poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā;
verses.english: They’re a good speaker who enunciates well. Their voice is polished, clear, articulate, and expresses the meaning.

verses.pali: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṁsako sabrahmacārīnaṁ.
verses.english: They educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with these six qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with five qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Katamehi pañcahi?
verses.english: What five?

verses.english: A mendicant is not quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.

verses.pali: sutānañca dhammānaṁ dhāraṇajātiko hoti;
verses.english: They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.

verses.pali: dhātānañca dhammānaṁ atthūpaparikkhitā hoti;
verses.english: They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.

verses.pali: atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammappaṭipanno ca hoti;
verses.english: Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.

verses.pali: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti …pe… atthassa viññāpaniyā;
verses.english: They’re a good speaker. Their voice is polished, clear, articulate, and expresses the meaning.

verses.pali: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṁsako sabrahmacārīnaṁ.
verses.english: They educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano alaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is good enough for themselves and others.

verses.pali: Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁ attano nālaṁ paresaṁ.
verses.english: A mendicant with four qualities is good enough for themselves but not for others.

verses.pali: Katamehi catūhi?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu;
verses.english: A mendicant is quick-witted when it comes to skillful teachings.

verses.pali: sutānañca dhammānaṁ dhāraṇajātiko hoti;
verses.english: They readily memorize the teachings they’ve heard.

verses.pali: dhātānañca dhammānaṁ atthūpaparikkhitā hoti;
verses.english: They examine the meaning of teachings they’ve memorized.

verses.pali: atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammappaṭipanno ca hoti;
verses.english: Understanding the meaning and the teaching, they practice in line with the teaching.

verses.english: But they’re not a good speaker and do not enunciate well. Their voice isn’t polished, clear, articulate, and doesn’t express the meaning.

verses.english: They don’t educate, encourage, fire up, and inspire their spiritual companions.
